Name: Genie Lamp Legit Wishing Definitive Edition
Author: Dragonfabri
Description:
Ever wanted an item not obtainable by regular gameplay? Maybe an environmental decoration? A quest item you were fond of? Or maybe something introduced with another mod? Don't want to cheat to get it?

The Genie Lamp will make your wish come true! In exchange for an exorbitant sum of 1 BILLION gold (you read that right) you can use the genie lamp to wish for A SINGLE COPY of ANY ITEM, no restrictions!

[color=#f1f1f1]Just go to the Travelling Cart in Cindersap Forest (every friday and sunday) to buy the lamp. [/color]Once used, you may search for any in-game item via the popup. Just write the ITEM ID (a google search will do the trick for vanilla items, for modded ones you need to input that instead): accepting the item will use up your lamp.

You can use this site for Vanilla items, modded ones need their own ID of course: https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids/

You want another lamp? Better start saving up again...

BE CAREFUL WHAT YOU WISH FOR: ANY ITEM can be granted, but some can't be removed once placed, and others were not meant for player hands! Wish at your own risk! If in doubt, make a backup before wishing.

Please check out the enclosed gif, showing how every item can be wished for both by ID and Qualified ID, but not by name! Qualified IDs ensure no mistakes can happen, so if you are afraid tghat some mods may have ids partly in common, just use the Qualified ID for a sure fire wish.


I hope you all enjoy this huge money sink, so that your currency is always worth its weight! Say goodbye to FOMO; no item is off-limits!


Commissioned by Dragonfabri, but made entirely by kedidili! I also made the suggestion on Github for Erinthe`s mod with the same name. But there are some key differences with that old version:

Unlike Erinthe's mod, code also works with qualified item IDs entered to the textbox, essentially, this is to be able to support wallpapers/floorings (because they all have same display name) and to have full mod item compatibility. You have to use the qualified item ID, just trying with display name wont work. So typing Prismatic shard wont give you anything, you have to write (O)74 for that.


Because display names or just internal names are gonna cause limitations, but qualified ids are always unique so the mod can give it a bullseye at finding the item

Also, Erinthe`s mod is a framework where you can "elect" an item to work as a wish, while this mod introduces a new item, at a balanced  money cost for the power it offers, and with the following:

[list]
[*]Use the Genie Lamp to wish for any singular item that exists in the game. ONE USE PER LAMP.
[*]Can search for items by ID.
[*]Price is editable in the mod config.
[/list]
